_readme: Settings for the exterior wall GWP tool. Choose 'building_type' from 'limits'. The limits are maximum values [kg CO2e/m2/year] for new buildings in the Danish building regulations (BR18 par. 298, from 1 July 2025). They are NOT in the Table 7 Excel file. They apply to the WHOLE building (modules A1-A3, B4, B6, C3, C4); there is no separate limit for walls. The tool therefore reports the walls' share of the limit, not compliance of the building.

average_new_building.source: Tillægsaftale om stramning af CO2e-krav til bygninger (2024): area-weighted average limit 7.1 kg CO2e/m2/year from 1 July 2025

single_family_or_terraced_house_150m2_pl.source: BR18 2025 differentiated limit for single-family houses, terraced houses and holiday homes >= 150 m2

holiday_home_under_150m2.source: BR18 2025 differentiated limit for holiday homes < 150 m2
